front.intro: Hardi Plank siding and a new roof cover the outside of this East End bungalow, and a new driveway runs back along the side of the house. Inside are new wiring, new plumbing and three-phase power, with a new kitchen and two new baths. Wood-look floors run from the front door through the Living Room, the Dining Area and the Kitchen. Interior laundry. Coral Sword and Greenway Coffee on Telephone Road are under half a mile away.

caps.name: Front of the Home
caps.text: A board and batten gable sits over the covered stoop at the front of the bungalow. A short flight of steps leads up to the stoop.

caps.name: Front Entry
caps.text: The front door opens straight into the Living Room, with the Dining Area and the Kitchen beyond it. Wood-look floors run from the door to the Kitchen with no thresholds between rooms. A tall double-pane window faces the street.

left.title: Living, Kitchen and the Breakfast Nook

cookItems.name: Kitchen
cookItems.text: The Kitchen is laid out in an L with a peninsula that opens to the Dining Area and the Living Room. The range, the sink and the dishwasher sit a step apart along the L. A pantry measuring 4' x 3' is just around the corner.

cookItems.name: Breakfast Bar
cookItems.text: The peninsula doubles as the Breakfast Bar between the Kitchen and the Dining Area. Two pendant lights hang above it. The Dining Area sits right beside the bar.

gatherItems.name: Living Room
gatherItems.text: The front door opens into the Living Room. Wood-look flooring runs through every main room. It faces the street, with a tall window to the front and a clerestory window set high on the wall that adds daylight and keeps privacy. A wide cased opening leads on through the Dining Area and into the Kitchen, over wood-look floors the whole way.

gatherItems.name: Dining Area
gatherItems.text: The Dining Area sits between the Kitchen peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms. The front door and the Living Room are on one side of it.

gatherItems.name: Breakfast Nook
gatherItems.text: The Breakfast Nook sits beside the Kitchen, with a door out to the rear deck and the backyard.

primItems.name: Primary Bedroom
primItems.text: A vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam, in the rear corner of the house away from the street. A double-door closet and the doorway to the Primary Bath share one wall.

primItems.name: Primary Closet
primItems.text: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower with hanging rods on both sides. The built-ins stay with the house. Shelves sit above the hanging rods on both sides.

bbItems.name: Primary Bath
bbItems.text: Double sinks sit on a dark navy vanity with drawers. The glass shower has a rain showerhead and a handheld, and marble-look tile from floor to ceiling. Brushed-finish faucets match the shower fixtures.

bbItems.name: Hall Bath
bbItems.text: Bedrooms 2 and 3 share the hall bath, a few steps from each. A window sits above the tub. Open shelves for linens line the wall beside the vanity.

bbItems.name: Bedroom 2
bbItems.text: The larger secondary bedroom sits at the front corner, across the home from the Primary. It shares the hall bath with Bedroom 3.

bbItems.name: Bedroom 3
bbItems.text: The hall bath is a few steps away. A large window brings in natural light, and a reach-in closet sits beside the door. The room sits between Bedroom 2 and the Primary. It sits next to the Primary.

back.title: Outside, with the layout beside it

photos.name: Covered Garage
photos.text: The covered garage sits at the back of the lot, beside an open concrete patio that measures 8' x 25'. The whole yard is fully fenced.

photos.name: Backyard Deck
photos.text: Steps lead from the Breakfast Nook's rear door down to the deck. The rear of the house shows the same Hardi Plank siding as the front.
